tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background: a warm paper white in light, a green-black in dark. Text on it: foreground, muted-foreground.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink: all primary text and active icons, on background and card (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and input surface. Text on it: foreground, muted-foreground.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card (same as foreground).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any accent fill.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Moss: the one brand colour. The primary button, links, the selected state, the focus ring, the Fern button. Use it for one thing per screen.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (8:1 light, 9.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet fills (same as muted).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: tracks, the person's chat bubble, segmented track, icon chips.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, details, captions, timestamps. 5.7:1 light, 7.6:1 dark on background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pressed tint for rows and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (brick, not alarm red).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between and around surfaces. Decorative only; controls use input.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline buttons: 3:1 or more on card in both themes.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2 pt solid.

tokens.name: chart-1

tokens.name: chart-5

tokens.name: hab
tokens.usage: Habits data colour. Colour lives in the data: chart fills and lines, sparklines, heatmap cells, dots and icons. Text stays in foreground or muted-foreground. Validated as a set (order tsk, fit, fin, hab, life, nut): colour-blind separation ≥ 8.9 ΔE and ≥ 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: tsk
tokens.usage: Tasks data colour. Colour lives in the data: chart fills and lines, sparklines, heatmap cells, dots and icons. Text stays in foreground or muted-foreground. Validated as a set (order tsk, fit, fin, hab, life, nut): colour-blind separation ≥ 8.9 ΔE and ≥ 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: fit
tokens.usage: Training and body data colour. Colour lives in the data: chart fills and lines, sparklines, heatmap cells, dots and icons. Text stays in foreground or muted-foreground. Validated as a set (order tsk, fit, fin, hab, life, nut): colour-blind separation ≥ 8.9 ΔE and ≥ 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: nut
tokens.usage: Nutrition data colour. Colour lives in the data: chart fills and lines, sparklines, heatmap cells, dots and icons. Text stays in foreground or muted-foreground. Validated as a set (order tsk, fit, fin, hab, life, nut): colour-blind separation ≥ 8.9 ΔE and ≥ 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: fin
tokens.usage: Money data colour. Colour lives in the data: chart fills and lines, sparklines, heatmap cells, dots and icons. Text stays in foreground or muted-foreground. Validated as a set (order tsk, fit, fin, hab, life, nut): colour-blind separation ≥ 8.9 ΔE and ≥ 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: life
tokens.usage: Stats, journal and Life Score data colour. Colour lives in the data: chart fills and lines, sparklines, heatmap cells, dots and icons. Text stays in foreground or muted-foreground. Validated as a set (order tsk, fit, fin, hab, life, nut): colour-blind separation ≥ 8.9 ΔE and ≥ 3:1 on card in both themes.
